## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(stringr)
library(ICAMS)
library(glue)
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)

indir1 <- "~/MEGA/important_mut_sig_data/fmh-unfiltered_vcfs"

sig17file <- "CPCT02250003T"
sig8file <- "CPCT02070336T"

s17path <- glue("{sig17file}_annotvcf.csv")
s8path <- glue("{sig8file}_annotvcf.csv")
```

## Read annotated InsDel17 and InsDel8 linking tumor VCFs

```{r}
#| label: read-tumor-vcfs
s17_gz <- file.path(indir1, paste0(sig17file, ".annotated.indel.vcf.gz"))
s8_gz <- file.path(indir1, paste0(sig8file, ".annotated.indel.vcf.gz"))

if (!file.exists(s17path)) {
  file_w_17_vcf <- fread(s17_gz)
  fwrite(file_w_17_vcf, s17path)
}

if (!file.exists(s8path)) {
  file_w_8_vcf <- fread(s8_gz)
  fwrite(file_w_8_vcf, s8path)
}
```

## Read annotated VCFs

```{r}
#| label: read-vcfs
file_w_17_vcf <- fread(s17path)
file_w_8_vcf <- fread(s8path)
```

## ID476 catalog plots

```{r}
#| label: build-catalogs
#| warning: false
build_ID476_catalog <- function(annotvcf, sample_id) {
  tmp476 <- annotvcf %>%
    dplyr::group_by(CHROM, POS) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      Koh_476 = Koh_476[1],
      R = R[1],
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Koh_476 = dplyr::if_else(
        R >= 9 &
          stringr::str_detect(
            Koh_476,
            "Del\\(T\\)|Del\\(C\\)|Ins\\(C\\)|Ins\\(T\\)"
          ),
        stringr::str_replace(Koh_476, "R\\d+", "R(9,)"),
        Koh_476
      )
    )
  tab <- table(tmp476$Koh_476)
  row_order <- ICAMS::catalog.row.order$ID476
  catalog <- setNames(rep(0L, length(row_order)), row_order)
  shared <- intersect(names(tab), row_order)
  catalog[shared] <- as.integer(tab[shared])
  catalog
}

cat17 <- build_ID476_catalog(file_w_17_vcf, sig17file)
cat8 <- build_ID476_catalog(file_w_8_vcf, sig8file)
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-sig17-476
#| fig-width: 18
#| fig-height: 5
mSigPlot::plot_ID476(
  cat17,
  plot_title = glue("{sig17file} (sig17 tumor) - ID476 spectrum"),
  num_peak_labels = 10
)
```


## Helper functions

```{r}
#| label: helper-del-counts
del_counts <- function(annotvcf) {
  annotvcf %>%
    dplyr::filter(nchar(ins_or_del_seq) >= 2) %>%
    dplyr::filter(ins_or_del == "d") %>%
    dplyr::filter(R <= 9) %>%
    dplyr::count(short_visual, Koh_476) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(n)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(vis2 = gsub("\\}", "", gsub("\\{", "", short_visual))) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(del_seq = str_extract(vis2, "(?<=<)[^>]+(?=>)")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(hasmh = grepl("\\{", short_visual))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: helper-normit
normit <- function(xx) {
  xx %>%
    mutate(post = gsub(".*>", "", vis2)) %>%
    mutate(post = gsub("\\[", "", post)) %>%
    mutate(clean = gsub("]", "", gsub("[><\\[]", "", vis2))) %>%
    mutate(
      norm = ifelse(substr(clean, 1, 1) %in% c("A", "G"), revc(clean), clean)
    ) %>%
    mutate(prop_n = n / sum(xx$n)) %>%
    select(Koh_476, norm, n, prop_n, short_visual)
}
```

## Summarize and normalize deletion types

```{r}
#| label: summarize
file_w_17_summary <- del_counts(file_w_17_vcf)
norm17 <- normit(file_w_17_summary)

file_w_8_summary <- del_counts(file_w_8_vcf)
norm8 <- normit(file_w_8_summary)
```

## Counts and relative counts of different deletion types

```{r}
#| label: display-tables
#| results: asis

all_norm <- bind_rows(
  norm17 %>% mutate(source = "sig17 tumor"),
  norm8 %>% mutate(source = "sig8 tumor")
)

# Match Koh_476 strings directly (they already use aggregated forms
# like "Del2:U(2,):R1" and "Del(7,):M1")
indel_types <- c(
  "Del2:U(2,):R1",
  "Del2:U2:R(5,9)",
  "Del(10,):U1:R1",
  "Del(10,):U(2,):R1",
  "Del4:M1",
  "Del(7,):M1",
  "Del(7,):M2",
  "Del(7,):M3"
)

for (deltype in indel_types) {
  cat("###", deltype, "\n\n")
  filtered <- all_norm %>%
    dplyr::filter(Koh_476 == deltype)
  if (nrow(filtered) == 0) {
    cat("No matching deletions found.\n\n")
    next
  }
  wide <- filtered %>%
    mutate(short_visual = gsub("<", "&lt;", gsub(">", "&gt;", short_visual))) %>%
    mutate(prop_n = sprintf("%.4f", prop_n), n = as.character(n)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(norm, short_visual),
      names_from = source,
      values_from = c(n, prop_n),
      names_glue = "{source} {.value}",
      names_vary = "slowest",
      values_fill = ""
    )

  # Compute totals
  prop_cols <- grep("prop_n", names(wide), value = TRUE)
  n_cols <- grep(" n$", names(wide), value = TRUE)
  totals <- list()
  for (nc in n_cols) {
    vals <- as.numeric(wide[[nc]][wide[[nc]] != ""])
    totals[[nc]] <- sum(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  for (pc in prop_cols) {
    vals <- as.numeric(wide[[pc]][wide[[pc]] != ""])
    totals[[pc]] <- sprintf("%.4f", sum(vals, na.rm = TRUE))
  }

  # Print totals outside the fold
  total_parts <- paste(
    sapply(n_cols, function(nc) paste0(nc, " = ", totals[[nc]])),
    sapply(prop_cols, function(pc) paste0(pc, " = ", totals[[pc]])),
    sep = ", "
  )
  cat(paste(total_parts, collapse = "; "), "\n\n")

  # Print full table inside a fold
  cat("<details><summary>Details</summary>\n\n")
  total_row <- setNames(as.list(rep("", ncol(wide))), names(wide))
  total_row[["norm"]] <- "**Total**"
  for (nc in n_cols) total_row[[nc]] <- as.character(totals[[nc]])
  for (pc in prop_cols) total_row[[pc]] <- totals[[pc]]
  bind_rows(wide, tibble(!!!total_row)) %>%
    knitr::kable() %>%
    print()
  cat("\n</details>\n\n")
}
```
